name: Forsaken Astartes
source: Mord Hive v0.5, pp.051-054 (Forsaken Astartes). Statlines from datasheets pp.052-053; equipment list p.052; the Damaged Astartes Plate 'mini-game', Astartes Bolter and Astartes special skills pp.053-054. Modelled (per the designer's note) on a nerfed Undead warband: one powerful hero plus semi-useless mooks. TODO: verify Hero skill-table access - the p.051 checkmark columns were ambiguous in the PDF text extraction.

heroSlots.notes: Exactly one per warband. Always equipped with Damaged Astartes Plate (counts as Carapace Armour that can never be removed; repaired over the campaign via scavenged Power Armour Components - see specialRules). TODO: verify skill-table access.

specialRules.name: Cause Fear
specialRules.description: Astartes are terrifying post-human monsters and cause fear.

specialRules.name: Immune to Psychology
specialRules.description: Not affected by psychology (such as fear) and never leaves combat.

specialRules.name: No Pain
specialRules.description: Treat a 'stunned' result on the Injury chart as 'knocked down'.

heroSlots.notes: Artificer: when searching for Power Armour Components, may add 2 to the rarity roll. May install found components into the Damaged Astartes Plate. TODO: verify skill-table access.
Trained: when searching for Power Armour Components, may add 1 to the rarity roll. TODO: verify skill-table access.

henchmenTypes.notes: Never gain experience. Mono-Task: on recruitment choose one - Weapons-Drill Servitor (WS4 BS2, shown above) or Targeting-Calibration Servitor (BS4 WS2). Having (or lacking) each type on the roster determines whether the Forsaken Astartes can use hand-to-hand / missile weapons that battle (see specialRules). Bought in groups of 1-5.

specialRules.name: No Pain
specialRules.description: Treat a stunned result on the Injury chart as knocked down.

henchmenTypes.notes: Rabble: groups must always be 3 or more and stay within 3" of each other; a group under 3 cannot enter a battle until refilled. The Angel Falls!: if the Forsaken Astartes is knocked down in line of sight, roll a Leadership test for the Rabble - fail = acts as failed All Alone; pass = gains frenzy for the battle (or until knocked down) and must move toward whatever knocked the Astartes down.

exclusiveEquipment.name: Astartes Bolter
exclusiveEquipment.rulesText: Max Range 30", Strength 4. Fire Twice (may fire twice per turn at an extra -1 to hit on both shots), Diamantine Tipped (saves at an extra -2 armour modifier), Explosive Bolt (models within 1.5" of a model hit suffer a S3 shooting hit), Rare Ammunition (must be restocked between battles: 4D6 Thrones, Rarity 8), Gene-Coded (gene-locked to its Astartes; usable only by the Astartes it was bought for).

exclusiveEquipment.name: Chain Weapon
exclusiveEquipment.rulesText: Any melee weapon upgraded to a Chain Weapon: +1 to Injury Rolls, strikes at -1 Initiative. Costs 3x the base weapon price.

exclusiveEquipment.name: Power Weapon
exclusiveEquipment.rulesText: Any melee weapon upgraded to a Power Weapon. Costs 4x the base weapon price. TODO: verify Power Weapon profile vs v0.5.

exclusiveEquipment.name: Heavy Stubber (Servitors only)
exclusiveEquipment.rulesText: Heavy Stubber, restricted to Servitors on this list. Same profile as the standard Heavy Stubber.

specialRules: Forsaken Astartes. My Armour is Contempt: instead of an Exploration Roll, any hero may Scavenge Parts (Availability Roll needs a 10; skills that help an Availability Roll apply). On finding a Power Armour Component, roll a D6 for which part; an Artificer not Out of Action at the end of the last battle may install found components into the Damaged Astartes Plate during the Trading step. Let not the Alien Live: may never hire any Xenos Hired Gun. High Maintenance: if no functional Weapons-Drill Servitor is on the roster at the start of a battle, the Astartes loses hand-to-hand weapons that battle (counts as a pair of clubs); if no functional Targeting-Calibration Servitor, he loses missile weapons (counts as armed with a throwing weapon only). | Damaged Astartes Plate: counts as Carapace Armour that can never be removed. Repaired over a campaign by scavenged parts (D6): 1 Auto-Sensors Relay (ignore long-range modifiers; find hidden models at 3x Initiative), 2 Repaired Muscle-Fibre Cortex (ignore negative Initiative modifiers on weapons, incl. double-handed strike-last), 3 Machine Spirit Reintegration (no -to hit for firing an Astartes Bolter twice), 4 Auto-Narthecium Refill (Medicae Kit restoring a wound once per battle; two uses then must be replaced), 5 Motive Actuators (+1 Move; not slowed by Carapace + shield), 6 Ablative Armour Repair (2+ save, degrades like other armour). Duplicate rolls give a spare. If the Astartes is taken out of action, on a D6 1-3 a random repaired subsystem is damaged again. | Min warband size 3, max 12. Bolt Pistol/Bolter/Hand Flamer are Heroes only; Heavy Stubber is Servitors only; Astartes Bolter is Forsaken Astartes only. | Astartes special skills (Academic): Discerning Eye (re-roll the D6 for which Power Armour Component was found), Ammunition Savant (spend one piece of Refined Diamantine to replenish Astartes Bolter ammo instead of finding fresh).
